title.description: Name of the template to which this report belongs.

service.description: The service to which the report belongs.

startDate.description: The data in this report belongs to dates greater than or equal to this.

endDate.description: The data in this report belongs to dates smaller than or equal to this.

siteList.description: The site to which this report belongs to. This only exists if the report belongs to service `Webex`.

created.description: Time of creation for this report.

createdBy.description: The person who created the report.

scheduledFrom.description: Whether this report was scheduled from API or Control Hub.

downloadURL.description: The link from which the report can be downloaded.
